parameters.query:
INSERT INTO glpi_n8n.chamados_log
  (conversa_id, glpi_ticket_id, glpi_ticket_url, titulo, menu_numero, menu_descricao,
   solicitante_nome, solicitante_email, solicitante_matricula, secretaria, coordenadoria,
   glpi_category_id, prioridade, resposta_glpi, dados_solicitacao)
VALUES (
  $1, $2,
  'https://suporte.araraquara.sp.gov.br/front/ticket.form.php?id=' || $2::text,
  $3, $4, $5,
  $6, $7, $8, $9, $10,
  $11, 2, '{}'::jsonb,
  $12::jsonb
) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
